run_subprocess_with_text_output: run subprocess commands that return decoded string stdout and stderr instead of bytes
decode_bytes_to_string: decode byte strings to text with GBK encoding fallback for non-UTF-8 content
patch_subprocess_run: patch subprocess.run to automatically convert stdout and stderr to decoded strings
add_memory_module_to_sys_path: add the memory module directory to sys.path for dynamic imports
handle_import_errors_with_hint: handle ImportError and AttributeError exceptions by printing a probing hint
